descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-92579 AC 2, 7, 8; UAT TC-24 ER 5-6 · “Deleting a patient hard-deletes all of their data immediately (backups per OAT-04) and keeps the audit log.”. Mixed: stated part — one app-style confirmation, Cancel keeps, OK deletes at once with the deleted message; rows gone, audit kept, removal logged; our part — Quick Dictation label and direct chart link landing on a defined state (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Bug B24 · S1 · known

Delete: Hospital uses the browser's native confirm and shows no 'deleted' toast; Nursing Home residents cannot be deleted at all

Tickets: TFA-92579 AC 7–8 ready for qa; TFA-94514 AC 1 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92579): no 'deleted' toast is AC 8; TC-24/S03 fails on the same evidence; Nursing Home has no trash icon and no screen calls snf.remove (TC-24/S05, dev U09).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-01/S16, TC-01/S17, OAT-06/S22, TC-24/S05, TC-24/S28

Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S03 Hospital patient delete from the card: one app-style pop-up, Cancel keeps, OK deletes everything at once, deleted message, nothing left behind, audit trail kept

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 Deleting a patient hard-deletes all of that patient's data immediately (removed, not hidden), and the audit log is kept. (UAT TC-24; TFA-92579 AC 2; TFA-94699 AC 4)
  • U7 Deleting a patient asks for confirmation exactly once: tapping the card's trash icon opens a pop-up designed like the app UI that says what deleting does, with Cancel and OK; Cancel keeps everything. (UAT TC-24; TFA-92579 AC 2; TFA-92579 AC 7; TFA-94699 AC 6)
  • T1 After a patient delete, an app-style confirmation message says "[Name]'s patient card was deleted". (TFA-92579 AC 8)
  • T3 No state a delete leads to shows a blank screen, a crash or a raw error: a deleted patient's chart link, the emptied patient list, a patient deleted while its note is generating, and a second device … (TFA-94745 AC 2; UAT Empty & Failure States)
  • T4 Deleting a patient is logged as one 'patient removed' analytics event with the removal reason and the care setting, in both modes. (TFA-94514 AC 1; UAT OAT-06 item 2)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh physician with the fixture Hospital patient, a Quick Dictation compartment about to be assigned to it, and a second Hospital patient kept as a control.

When Type a Quick Dictation compartment and assign it to the patient; open the chart once and go back. Tap the card's trash icon, save a checkpoint while the confirmation is shown, press Cancel; tap it again and press OK. Reopen Quick Dictation. Open /rounding/<deleted id> directly.

Then One pop-up designed like the app says what deleting does (all of this patient's data, permanently) and offers Cancel and OK. Cancel keeps the patient. OK removes the card at once, shows "<Name>'s patient card was deleted" and leaves the control patient. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-92579 AC 2/7/8, TFA-94745 AC 2, TFA-94514 AC 1 and UAT TC-24. oracle.mjs: cp2 an in-page dialog with Cancel and OK (a native browser confirm leaves no dialog in the snapshot and fails AC 7, Q10); cp3 the card is still there; cp4 the name plus "s patient card was deleted" (accepts a straight or a curly apostrophe, Q10), no 'Open chart for <name>', control present; …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S03 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-24.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-24 Deletions · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-24/S03

Not re-run (reviews of TFA-92579 and TFA-94514). The run's own result was fail; its evidence is below.
